request_summary: Commit and push the GEC review fixes within an exact file scope, after the human accepted the known verification gaps.

actions.description: First attempt: blocked before staging because the verification did not cover the issuer path and the temporary configuration override; no Git write happened.

After the explicit human decision, it first reported an unexpected configuration diff, which the orchestrator disproved with the raw diff; on recheck it staged only the 12 authorized paths, ran the whitespace check, committed with the exact message and pushed normally.
The orchestrator confirmed the commit on the remote branch and on the pull request.

outcome.detail: Publication completed with the declared verification gaps; the first block and the unexpected-diff report were correctly cautious but the latter was a transient observation.

friction.description: The closer reported a dev.yaml difference that was not present on recheck, probably observed while a temporary override was still applied, costing one extra round.
Git printed a cache-daemon error line during the push even though the push succeeded.
